notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Karn's Touch by paying {U}{U}, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
